answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement of 0.852, sequence agreement of 0.312, KL of 0.395, TV of 0.152 and Token-DiFR gap of 0.691 are all at or beyond the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48, 0.197-0.339, 0.108-0.144, 0.28-0.52). They are far outside the quantized and fine-tuned ranges (KL up to 0.205, top-1 at least 0.900). Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.3 fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and is also within the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8), but the size of the logit change favors system-prompted. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, since a strong fine-tune could push the values this high, but these are all more extreme than any fine-tuned model seen.
